title: Troll A 海上平台
summary: 以Troll A大型海上結構為背景，分開固定基礎承載、波浪作用與材料量測；不把浮體模型誤用到海床固定結構。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Troll A to distinguish fixed-foundation loading, waves and material measurements, explicitly avoiding misuse of floating-body models for a seabed-supported structure. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 區分波能密度與結構載荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Distinguish wave-energy density and structural loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 區分波能密度與結構載荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Distinguish wave-energy density and structural loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 區分波能密度與結構載荷：線性規則波的平均總能量密度與波高平方成正比；有效波高的不規則波公式係數不同。 本步以「波浪能量密度」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish wave-energy density and structural loading: Mean total energy density of a linear regular wave scales with height squared; the coefficient differs for irregular waves described by significant height. Use Wave-energy density to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Troll A 海上平台實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²、規則波高H=1.296 m。式 E=ρgH²/8，基準結果 2111.1198 J/m²。條件：線性規則波、平均每水平面積能量，不是功率；功率還需乘群速。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Troll A offshore platform: ρ=1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², regular wave height H=1.296 m. Formula E=ρgH²/8 gives 2111.1198 J/m². Conditions: Linear regular wave, mean energy per horizontal area, not power; power also needs group velocity.
steps.failure: 把振幅代入波高會少算四倍能量；先核對H與a的定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Substituting amplitude for height underestimates energy by a factor of four; check definitions of H and a. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 從合成水位訊號量峰谷差而非把振幅當波高；標明規則波或不規則海況。 本案例另須檢查「區分波能密度與結構載荷」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Measure peak-to-trough height from a synthetic elevation trace rather than amplitude; label regular versus irregular conditions. Also check that Distinguish wave-energy density and structural loading and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：區分波能密度與結構載荷。在固定平台剖面、載荷路徑、合成波浪與腐蝕格網完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加規則波高10%，檢查21%能量增幅，勿直接視為發電增幅。 算式區的基準值為2111.1198，改變後為2554.455 J/m²。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Distinguish wave-energy density and structural loading. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Fixed-platform section, load paths, synthetic waves and corrosion grid. Increase regular wave height alone by 10%, check a 21% energy increase and do not equate it directly with electrical gain. Baseline 2111.1198 changes to 2554.455 J/m². Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。

Measure peak-to-trough height from a synthetic elevation trace rather than amplitude; label regular versus irregular conditions. Also check that Distinguish wave-energy density and structural loading and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：辨識流體相對固定結構的速度。在固定平台剖面、載荷路徑、合成波浪與腐蝕格網完成資料或紙面模型練習。只提高相對速度10%，比較平方律的21%增幅。 算式區的基準值為68.864256，改變後為83.32575 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Identify flow speed relative to a fixed structure. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Fixed-platform section, load paths, synthetic waves and corrosion grid. Raise relative speed alone by 10% and compare the 21% quadratic increase. Baseline 68.864256 changes to 83.32575 N. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
